meta.name: Vinewood Hills Patrol & Incident Response (RPH)
meta.author: GTA-Anything Clean-Room
meta.description: RAGE Plugin Hook (RPH) clean-room patrol and incident response loop spanning Vinewood Hills and Downtown Los Santos with static 2D unit cards, vanilla fallback vehicles (police3/fbi2), ranger field liaison NPC, and deterministic WorldSession OnUnload teardown.

states.name: Idle
states.description: RPH plugin loaded and standing by for LeftControl+F10 dispatch menu hotkey.

states.name: MenuSelecting
states.description: Browsing Vinewood patrol sectors and 2D static_sprite unit cards without spawning 3D vehicles.

states.name: ResourceStreaming
states.description: Streaming police3/fbi2 patrol vehicle and s_m_y_ranger_01 liaison NPC models with timeout release and vanilla fallback.

states.name: SpawningShift
states.description: Spawning patrol unit at Vinewood Hills Observatory Overlook, verifying non-null handle, registering lease in WorldSession, and seating player.

states.name: ActivePatrol
states.description: Patrolling Vinewood Hills and Downtown incident response zones, checking in with ranger liaison NPC, and clearing calls.

states.name: ShiftSummary
states.description: Displaying patrol response summary and cleared zone stipend before RPH teardown.

states.name: Teardown
states.description: Deterministic WorldSession.DisposeAll() releasing all leased patrol vehicles, liaison NPCs, blips, and model handles (also wired to RPH OnUnload).

evidence.extracted_fact: RPH patrol and incident response lifecycle: LeftControl+F10 static_sprite menu -> SafeModelStreamer (police3/fbi2 + s_m_y_ranger_01) -> 4 Vinewood/Downtown patrol zones -> ShiftSummary -> WorldSession OnUnload teardown.
4 Vinewood Hills & Downtown patrol/incident response zones (Observatory Overlook, Vinewood Sign Ridge, Vinewood Blvd Precinct, Mission Row Hub) with $150 stipend per cleared zone.
